title: AION 2 Cleric Build: Starting PvE Skills and Healing Choices
description: Build an AION 2 Cleric for solo or party PvE with a sourced Stigma example, debuff order, healing decisions, and Chanter-dependent adjustments.
summary: Prepare healing, cleanse, and resurrection, then add a damage loop that fits your unlocked skills. Compare low-level and TW-experience examples without copying endgame limits.

workflow.title: Recover the party without losing the encounter
workflow.caption: A conditional response guide: choose the recovery that addresses the problem and cast only when the mechanic permits.

steps.label: Check the immediate danger
steps.description: Move or protect yourself if the current mechanic would interrupt or kill you during recovery.

steps.label: Identify the needed response
steps.description: Distinguish ordinary damage, a removable effect, and a dead ally; check what your available skill can address.

steps.label: Stabilize safely
steps.description: Use the needed heal or cleanse, or find a safe resurrection window. Keep these controls outside damage repetition.

steps.label: Resume useful damage
steps.description: Once recovery is covered, refresh the demonstrated debuffs and use only the damage interactions your options support.
